name: @domains/adapter
description: The source registry and the adapter contract: the source.json shape and its validator, the append-only bit map, the segment and cursor types, the volume band check, the TCP recording and its replay as ctx.connect, and the harness that runs an adapter against recorded answers. ./kafka is the adapters' one Kafka client (KafkaConnection over ctx.connect), and ./kafka-protocol its request bytes, parses and batch decode, which the probe's /kafka route reads too. src/ runs in Node and in workerd, and imports one type of @domains/names (the loaded list, ctx.psl); node/ holds the Node-only file readers, liveConnect and runSandboxed.
